Underhill Investment Management Llc decreased its stake in First American Financial (FAF) by 7.94% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Underhill Investment Management Llc sold 24,500 shares as the company’s stock rose 2.97% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 284,150 shares of the specialty insurers company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $15.92M, down from 308,650 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Underhill Investment Management Llc who had been investing in First American Financial for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $5.74B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.38% or $0.72 during the last trading session, reaching $51.51. About 830,283 shares traded or 7.18% up from the average. First American Financial Corporation (NYSE:FAF) has risen 49.42% since April 29, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 37.87% the S&P500.
